The court was able to review this case and the court reached the right conclusion. But Congress does have other tools at its disposal to deal with presidential overreach. And I think it needs to be more aggressive in doing that. This is an issue that's neither Republican nor Democratic. It's neither liberal nor conservative. It's simply American.
